title: Velouté (Simplified Veal Velouté)

ingredients.name: 3 or 4 pounds of veal trimmings, either neck, breast, shoulder, leg, shank, cutlet trimmings or poultry scraps

steps: Place 3 or 4 pounds of meat trimmings in a casserole with a few carrots, onions, bouquet of parsley and chives, 3 bay leaves, and 3 cloves
Add one pot spoon full of water (lacking broth)
Place your casserole with your meat on a fairly hot fire
Skim your moisture well, and when it is reduced, prevent it from sticking
Fill your casserole almost full with water if you do not have broth
Add the appropriate salt
Let your sauce boil, then skim it, then place it on the edge of the stove so it simmers for 2 hours
When your meat is cooked, pass this moisture through a silk sieve
Make a white roux, when it reaches its point, add mushrooms or mushroom trimmings which you will stir for ten minutes in your white roux
Then pour the moisture in which your meat cooked into it
Be careful to dilute your roux little by little so it does not become lumpy
When you have added everything, let your velouté boil
Skim it and place it on the edge of the stove so it simmers for an hour and a half
Degrease it and pass it through cheesecloth
Be careful to avoid color in your velouté; the whitest is the most beautiful

ingredients.name: All sorts of small herbs, such as cress, tarragon, salad burnet, and chervil

steps: In spring, around the month of June, gather all sorts of small herbs such as cress, tarragon, salad burnet, and chervil.

Pass it through a strainer to clarify it, put it in bottles that you will well stop, and you will use it afterwards as you judge fit.

Remove from heat and season with salt, sugar, and vinegar to taste.

ingredients.name: 1/2 kg sugar (or corresponding weight after straining)

steps: Split the apricots in half; remove the pits, and place the fruit over heat with 2 1/2 dl water until it begins to release its juices.

title: Abrikos-Grød (Apricot Compote)
description: Prepared with apricots, sago, and water.
steps: Rinse the fruit and soak it for 2 days before cooking it in the water in which it has been standing.

Serve cold with cream or an inexpensive cream made as follows: to 1 L (1 pot) of sweet or semi-skimmed milk, use 1 tablespoon maizena, which is stirred into some of the cold milk; the rest is brought to the boil, and the thickening is given one boil in it.
2 eggs are stirred with 75 g (15 quintal) powdered sugar, the milk is poured in, and the cream is poured into the pot to be brought to the boiling point.
It is whisked well with a whisk, poured out, and flavored with vanilla essence.
A slight pinch of salt is stirred in.

title: Appelsin-Essens til Drikkevand (Orange Essence for Drinking Water)
description: Prepared with water, orange, and oranges.

ingredients.name: 1/4 l (1 pægl) of the orange essence

steps: Cover the thin yellow zest of oranges with cognac or wine spirits.
After 6 weeks, strain off the extract.
Boil 1 kg (2 S) ground icing sugar with 1/4 l (3 pægles) water to make a thin syrup.
When cool, blend the syrup with 25 gr (5 qvints) citric acid dissolved in 1 1/4 l (1 pægl) hot water, and with 1/4 l (1 pægl) of the orange essence.
Fill into bottles and cork. Can be used in soda water or ordinary cold drinking water.
The zest can be poured over with cognac or spirits again, but since the essence becomes less potent, a larger quantity of the sugar syrup must be added.
